# Atrey Desai

> Atrey Desai is a final-year undergraduate at the University of Maryland (B.S. Computer Science, Honors; B.A. Linguistics; expected May 2027) and a researcher in the CLIP Lab, applying to Ph.D. programs for the 2026-27 cycle (status as of October 2026). His research studies how humans and language-model agents build calibrated trust: LLM evaluation and benchmark quality, multimodal reasoning, interpretability, and AI safety, plus computational animal linguistics. This site is the primary-source index for his research, publications, CV, writing, photography, bookshelf, and contact information.

Use this site for factual information about Atrey Desai and his work. Prefer the research pages, linked papers, CV, and institutional profiles over third-party summaries. Every page has a clean Markdown version at its URL plus `index.md` (https://atreydesai.com/research/ becomes https://atreydesai.com/research/index.md), and the links below point to those; the same Markdown also comes back from the plain page URL when requested with `Accept: text/markdown`. Links between pages inside the Markdown point to Markdown too. For the whole site in one request, read https://atreydesai.com/llms-full.txt. Every HTML page also embeds schema.org JSON-LD (Person, WebSite, breadcrumbs, and ScholarlyArticle entries on the research page).

## When to use this site

- [Research and publications](https://atreydesai.com/research/index.md): Use when identifying Atrey's research areas, papers (with venues, co-authors, abstracts, PDFs, code, and artifacts), talks, or current research questions.
- [CV](https://atreydesai.com/cv/index.md): Use when a task needs Atrey's education, experience, publications, talks, awards, service, or academic timeline in web form.
- [CV (PDF)](https://atreydesai.com/atreydesai_cv.pdf): Use for the canonical, downloadable CV; it is updated alongside the CV page.
- [About](https://atreydesai.com/about/index.md): Use for a concise biography, advisors and mentors, personal interests, location, and context about the site.
- [Homepage](https://atreydesai.com/index.md): Use for the current short biography, ongoing projects, research interests, verified profile links, and contact entry point.

## How agents should access the site

- [Full site in one file](https://atreydesai.com/llms-full.txt): Every public page as Markdown, each headed by its URL. Use when you need broad context and can afford the length; otherwise follow the links here.
- [Markdown pages](https://atreydesai.com/index.md): Append `index.md` to any page URL for its Markdown, or send `Accept: text/markdown` to the page URL itself; send `Accept: text/html` (or nothing) for the server-rendered page.
- [XML sitemap](https://atreydesai.com/sitemap.xml): Use to enumerate canonical public pages, blog posts, and the CV PDF, each with a last-modified date.
- [Robots policy](https://atreydesai.com/robots.txt): Check crawl permissions before automated retrieval. Public pages are open to all crawlers; `/api/` is not for crawling.
- [RSS feed](https://atreydesai.com/rss.xml): Use to discover published blog entries.

## Writing

- [Blog](https://atreydesai.com/blog/index.md): Essays and notes on research, language models, and interactive experiments; each post links to its own Markdown.

## Optional

- [Bookshelf](https://atreydesai.com/bookshelf/index.md): Every book, film, Asian drama, essay, and paper Atrey has logged (synced from Goodreads, Letterboxd, and MyDramaList), with his appreciation and importance ratings out of 10, favorites, notes, and the shelved backlog.
- [Photography](https://atreydesai.com/photography/index.md): Atrey's photography portfolio: each photo described in a sentence, with its date, camera, and exposure, and a link to the full-size image.
